nuggets.text: Jaylin Carter's four rushing touchdowns against Arkansas State tied a Tigers record shared with DeAngelo Williams.
Jaylin Carter ran for 110 yards in the third quarter alone against Arkansas State, including a 74-yard burst.
The Tigers have won six straight Paint Bucket Bowls against Arkansas State.
The Tigers have a chance to start 3-0 for a fourth straight season.
Charles Huff walked on at Hampton, spent time at tight end and guard, then became the starting center.
Charles Huff coached Saquon Barkley at Penn State and Najee Harris at Alabama before taking over the Tigers.
Geoffrey Cantin-Arku returned a blocked field goal 80 yards in the Tigers' 35-32 win over Boise State in 2023.
Twenty of the Tigers' 22 starters arrived through the transfer portal in Charles Huff's first season.
The Paint Bucket Bowl trophy the Tigers play Arkansas State for was first made from buckets of paint and paint brushes.
Before home games, the Tigers, the band and fans march into the stadium together in the Tiger Walk.
